Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorChartIGV

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorChartIGV
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CompressorChartIGV extends Object implements Serializable
Rigorous inlet-guide-vane (IGV) chart family for a centrifugal Compressor.

Where InletGuideVaneModel applies generic parametric corrections on top of a single fully-open chart, this class holds a vendor performance map per IGV position (each a complete set of speed lines with flow, head and polytropic efficiency) and interpolates them into a standard CompressorChart at any requested opening. This mirrors how the expander charts in TurboMachineryChartLibrary carry IGV-position curve families.

Positions are given as opening fractions in [0, 1] (1 = fully open). getChartAtOpening(double) linearly interpolates the flow, head and efficiency curves between the two bracketing positions (clamping to the nearest position outside the supplied range) and regenerates the surge curve, returning a ready-to-use CompressorChart. All supplied positions must share the same speed lines and array shapes.
